pricing.context_threshold_scope: Per model request, using full input. More than 272000 input tokens reprices the full request. Aggregate turn input is not one model request.
pricing.input_partition: ordinary_input_tokens = total_input_tokens - cached_input_tokens - cache_write_input_tokens; ordinary, cache-read and cache-write prices are alternatives, not additive.
pricing.output_partition: Reasoning output is already included in output_tokens and must not be added again.
pricing.estimate_kind: API list-price-equivalent; not actual ChatGPT/Codex billing

provenance.reading_scope: Official API pricing, flagship Standard/Batch/Flex/Fast/Ultrafast rows, regional footnote and tool billing notes; selected sections, not every model.
Exact GPT-6.1 Sol model identity, pricing, >272K condition and tier multipliers; model main content reviewed.
Main caching guide, input partition, cache-write rates and usage fields, model comparison and cost calculation; selected sections, not every example.

pricing.native_usage_caveat: Codex 0.159.2 JSONL reports cache_write_input_tokens, but its wire parser defaults a missing upstream cache_write_tokens field to zero. A reported zero does not prove upstream explicit zero.
pricing.cache_write_sensitivity: Report native-reported W point estimate and an all-noncached-input-written sensitivity: set W = total_input_tokens - cached_input_tokens. This is a hypothetical upper scenario under the same tariff, not observed billing.
unknowns: Actual account tariff, discounts and charges
Server-confirmed service tier and endpoint billing classification
Whether native-reported cache-write zero was explicit upstream zero or parser default
Local compute, hosting and any separately charged external-service costs

formula: ((I-C-W)*uncached_rate + C*cached_rate + W*write_rate + O*output_rate)/1,000,000; R is already included in O

policy.correctness: Every original candidate assignment succeeds with verified source/native fidelity
policy.coverage: Complete unique matched A/B/C triplets for every task and repeat; no missing or unknown cost
policy.nonregression: Focused cost per attempt and full execution time: candidate mean AND median <= each baseline overall AND in each repeat

limitations: Every dollar amount is a standard API list-price equivalent, not actual provider billing or a subscription charge.
Cache writes reported as zero may reflect an upstream default. Conservative possible-write ranges are scenarios, not confidence intervals.
Each native attempt is priced once. All failures and unknown attempts remain in per-arm numerators; unknown usage prevents a complete total or cost per success.
Cached input is included in total input and reasoning is included in output; neither is billed twice.
Completed command/file-change items are invocation/patch proxies, not provider model calls, individual file reads or unique edits. Missing telemetry remains null.
Local CPU is a sampled lower bound; child RSS can double-count shared pages and omits parent indexing. Neither has a fabricated dollar rate.
Provided-context controls are excluded from source-benefit promotion checks. Repeat consistency is descriptive, not statistical proof.
Fresh small synthetic tasks with uncontrolled provider/OS caches do not establish production, long-term memory or universal efficiency gains.
